Interface ProductView

All Superinterfaces:
BaseView
All Known Implementing Classes:
SwingStoreView
public interface ProductView extends BaseView
View interface for product inventory management operations and display. Extends BaseView to provide product-specific user interactions including product menu display, product information visualization, and category/subcategory selection.

  • Method Details

    • displayProductMenu

      void displayProductMenu()
      Displays the product management menu to the user. Typically includes options for viewing, adding, updating, removing products, searching, and inventory management.

    • getProductMenuChoice

      int getProductMenuChoice()
      Gets the user's selection from the product management menu.
      Returns:
      the user's menu choice as an integer

    • displayProducts

      void displayProducts(List<ProductDTO> products)
      Displays a list of products to the user. Shows product information in a list format, typically with summary details for each product.
      Parameters:
      products - the list of ProductDTO objects to display

    • displayProduct

      void displayProduct(ProductDTO product)
      Displays detailed information for a single product. Shows comprehensive product details including pricing, inventory, category, and expiration information.
      Parameters:
      product - the ProductDTO containing detailed product information to display

    • displayLowStockProducts

      void displayLowStockProducts(List<ProductDTO> products)
      Displays products that are low in stock. Typically highlights products with quantities below threshold to alert for restocking needs.
      Parameters:
      products - the list of low stock ProductDTO objects to display

    • displayExpiredProducts

      void displayExpiredProducts(List<ProductDTO> products)
      Displays products that have expired or are nearing expiration. Typically shows products that need attention due to expiration dates.
      Parameters:
      products - the list of expired ProductDTO objects to display

    • getCategoryInput

      CategoryDTO getCategoryInput()
      Prompts the user to select a product category from available options. This method should present all available product categories to the user and return the selected category as a DTO. The implementation should handle user cancellation gracefully, typically by returning a default category.
      Returns:
      the selected CategoryDTO, or a default category if user cancels

    • getSubcategoryInput

      SubcategoryDTO getSubcategoryInput(CategoryDTO category)
      Prompts the user to select a product subcategory based on the selected category. This method presents only the subcategories that belong to the specified parent category. The implementation should filter subcategories appropriately and allow the user to select from the filtered list.
      Parameters:
      category - the parent CategoryDTO to filter subcategories by
      Returns:
      the selected SubcategoryDTO, or null if no subcategories exist or user cancels selection
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if category is null
